snippet.title: Yathsel | Official Gameplay Trailer | Cheat or Die in a Wild West Saloon #shorts
snippet.description:
Wishlist Yathsel on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4871350
Yathsel is a first-person dice game set in a Wild West saloon where every outlaw at the table cheats. Spot the trick, call it out, or get fleeced.

Take a seat, shake the cup and roll for the best hand. But keep your eyes on the other side of the table: every crook has a signature trick and a tell that gives it away. Catch them in the act and they pay for it. Accuse the wrong moment and you pay instead.

FEATURES
• Real 3D dice, rolled from a leather cup, seen through your own eyes
• A campaign against a gallery of outlaws, each with a unique cheating trick
• Catch cheaters red-handed, or become one yourself
• A smuggler's shop under the table: buy artifact dice and hide them in your pouch
• Online multiplayer for up to 5 friends at one table
• Playable in 9 languages

Try the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4871350

Wishlisting helps a small indie game more than anything else. Thank you!

#Yathsel #IndieGame #DiceGame
